title_zh: 确认社区午餐的供餐与横幅分工

scenario.label_zh: 确认社区午餐供餐与指示横幅分工
scenario.goal_zh: 确认厨房可为四十人提供午餐，并约定活动方制作指向侧门的横幅

context_zh: 社区午餐筹办人与活动中心厨房负责人协调当天安排。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Etta
sentences.text: Can your kitchen cater for forty people at our community lunch next Tuesday?

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: Yes, if we use the soup-and-roll menu we discussed. Lunch will be served through the side door.

sentences.speaker: Etta
sentences.text: People usually go to the front entrance. We'll need a banner directing them to the lunch.

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: Could your volunteers make that? My team can handle the food, but not the signs.

sentences.speaker: Etta
sentences.text: Certainly. We'll put 'Community lunch: side entrance' on it and hang it beside the front gate.

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: Then we're set: the kitchen prepares forty lunches, and your team handles the banner.
